entrypoints.name: length
entrypoints.input: A finite OCaml list of values of arbitrary, uniform element type.
entrypoints.output: A nonnegative int equal to the number of cons cells in the input list.
entrypoints.semantic_contract: For every list xs, length xs = cardinality(xs). The result counts every occurrence, including duplicate values; it is independent of element values and preserves no element ordering because the result is an integer.
entrypoints.failure_behavior: No domain failure is specified for finite OCaml lists.
entrypoints.tail_recursion: The upstream statement calls tail recursion a bonus; it is not a semantic acceptance requirement.

necessary_type_declarations.note: Built-in OCaml list type; declaration shown for interface clarity, not to be redefined in Generated.

necessary_type_declarations.declaration: data List a where Nil :: List a; Cons :: x:a -> xs:List a -> List a
necessary_type_declarations.note: A separate inductive model used only by contract.sq.

trusted_primitives.role: Generic eliminator for the logical List model.

trusted_primitives.role: Trusted logical termination/size measure: Nil maps to 0 and each Cons adds one to the tail measure.
